verdict.rationale: Vanta's questionnaire automation generates responses to new questionnaires from a knowledge base and prior answers, leaving users to review, approve, and submit. The API also exposes endpoints for managing Customer Trust questionnaire responses. None of the evidence covers the story's central point: handling questionnaires in many formats and returning them in the customer's original format. Missing for 10: documented import of SIG/CAIQ/spreadsheet files, portal-based questionnaire support, export in the original customer format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
